Why we’re here

Sharing what we have. Making room for hope.

Zakaliya Shared Blessings Ministry was founded in 2024 to share donations and support with people in need.

Our mission is simple: to share blessings with those in need and help create opportunities for growth. We believe generosity can strengthen a community, one act of care at a time.

“The generous will themselves be blessed, for they share their food with the poor.”Proverbs 22:9 · NIV

Our work

Care with a lasting purpose.

Explore the programs and building projects supported by the ministry.

Kids Support Program

Supporting children with essential resources and opportunities to learn and thrive. The program works to create a nurturing environment where children can grow.

Two Block Classroom

The two-block classroom is complete. Work is underway to add another three-block classroom as the number of pupils grows.

Pre-School Construction

A three-block classroom is under construction for the children the ministry supports, creating more room for learning and growth.

Church Building

The completed church is a place for worship and community gathering. As people began using it during the week, the ministry started work on a pre-school.

Looking ahead

New skills. New possibilities.

The ministry has identified two future projects to help more young people build practical skills and support their families.

Tailoring school

A future learning space where young people can develop sewing skills and pathways to support themselves and their families.

Planned project

Farming project

A future opportunity to learn cultivation skills and put them to use for stronger livelihoods and family wellbeing.

Planned project
